method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Colour models on the colour page
features.detail: RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK and more, each value listed
features.verse_evidence: 15 models (RGB, HSL, HSV / HSB, HWB, CMYK, Hunter Lab, Oklab, OKLCH, ...)

features.name: Related colours
features.verse_evidence: swatches click through; no "similar colours" list

features.name: Palettes that use the colour
features.verse_evidence: Palettes made from it: eight palettes of five built around the colour (monochrome, analogous, complementary, triadic, pastel, muted, with neutrals, bold contrast), each starting with it (lib/palettes.js); made by rules, not a community

features.name: Create and save palettes (account)
features.detail: members make, name and save palettes; likes and comments
features.verse_evidence: Your palette: add colours, name and save palettes on this device (no account), edit, copy as CSS variables, paint the wheel with one

features.name: Colour picker
features.verse_evidence: input type="color" beside the text box

features.name: Colour names list
features.verse_evidence: 148 CSS names understood; no browse list

features.name: Web-safe colours
features.verse_evidence: The 216 web-safe colours, opened on tap, with the nearest web-safe colour to this one (lib/palettes.js WEB_SAFE)

features.name: Text preview on the colour
features.verse_evidence: WCAG contrast block shows text on it
